characters.look: a young dark-haired man in a dark red leather coat with a crimson hood holding a short wand
characters.setting: a walled sandstone training courtyard in an autumn old town with three wooden training dummies on round stands, stacked wooden crates and square sandstone pillars

ranged_attack.text: raises his wand at {target}, orange flame gathering at its tip, and hurls a blazing fireball that explodes in a bright orange flash on it and vanishes at once
